title: OrbitalSystem
description: A complete initial (or current) state of an Orbit simulation: integration parameters plus every body's position, velocity, size, density, color, and optional name. Written by OrbitalSystem.saveToFile() and read by OrbitalSystem.loadFromFile(); the R key reloads and runs whatever this file currently holds.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to this schema, for editor validation/autocomplete

trailLength.description: Number of past positions each body remembers for its trailing path

trailDecimation.description: Simulation steps between recorded trail points

enforceRadiusLimit.description: Whether bodies that stray past 3x maxRadiusAU from the origin are culled

maxRadiusAU.description: Reference system radius, AU; escape-culling threshold is 3x this

name.description: Optional display name, e.g. "Earth"; omitted for unnamed bodies

positionAU.description: [X, Y] inertial position of center-of-mass, astronomical units

velocityMS.description: [U, V] inertial velocity of center-of-mass, meters/second
